title: fix(mcp,runtime)!: the stateless /api/v1/mcp answers GET and DELETE with 405 Allow: POST
body:
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

Closes #25759

Dispatched directly by the maintainer through the cloud ops seat: 「objectstack#25759 你直接派发处理」 (claim: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/25759#issuecomment-6396055207).

## What changes

`MCPServerRuntime.handleHttpRequest` (`@objectstack/mcp`), the one function every host calls for `/api/v1/mcp`, now answers every verb but `POST` with `405`, `Allow: POST` and the MCP SDK transport's own JSON-RPC 405 body (`{"jsonrpc":"2.0","error":{"code":-32000,"message":"Method not allowed."},"id":null}`). It answers before a server is built, so a refused verb pays for no tool registration. `POST` is untouched.

- **GET.** The transport is stateless (`sessionIdGenerator: undefined`, `enableJsonResponse: true`) and closes its per-request server in `finally`. A GET reached the SDK's `handleGetRequest`, which answered `200 text/event-stream` and lost the stream when the server closed. Measured on `5874d25302` through `handleHttpRequest`: `200`, `text/event-stream`, empty body, ~13 ms; through both host doors: `200`. The Streamable HTTP transport says a server that offers no GET stream answers `405`, and the SDK client (`client/streamableHttp.js`, `_startOrAuthSse`) returns quietly on a `405` and does not retry.
- **DELETE.** The spec lets a server that does not end sessions answer `405`. This server never issues a session id, the SDK client sends DELETE only for an issued one (`terminateSession` returns early without it, and accepts `405`), and the old answer was `200` for ending nothing. Same treatment, so `Allow: POST` is true.
- **Every other verb** was already `405` from the SDK transport, with an `Allow: GET, POST, DELETE` that named two verbs this surface cannot serve. Now `Allow: POST`.
- **Hosts.** A `createHonoApp` host's catch-all hands every verb on `/mcp` to `dispatch()`, and cloud's MCP ceiling proxies `handleHttpRequest`, so both reach this function after the dispatcher's anonymous `401` with no change. **The standalone server needed one change** (`@objectstack/runtime`, `dispatcher-plugin.ts`, contract review round 1): it mounts `/mcp` for GET, POST and DELETE only and did not declare the path with `domainDecidesEveryVerb` (#24228), so on `HonoServerPlugin` a `PUT`, a `PATCH` or an `OPTIONS` with CORS off matched no route and the adapter answered it itself (`405`, `Allow: DELETE, GET, HEAD, POST`, a `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` envelope), to an anonymous caller too, before the `401` (ADR-0138 D2). `/mcp` is now declared like `/mcp/skill` and `/keys`, so every unrouted verb goes to `dispatch()`: the `401` first, then the transport's `405 Allow: POST`, as on the hosted door. GET and DELETE stay mounted. The resolver-absence warn now names `/mcp`, and the stale mount comment (GET as SSE, DELETE as a session end) is corrected.
- **Known clients that need the GET stream:** none. The stateless server never sends a server-initiated message, so nothing was ever delivered on that stream.

## Tests

- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.http-verbs.test.ts` (new, 5 tests): GET with claude-code's headers answers `405` `Allow: POST` with the JSON-RPC body and reads no bridge member; DELETE (with and without a session id) the same; PUT/PATCH/OPTIONS/HEAD the same; `POST initialize` → `notifications/initialized` (202) → `tools/list` round trip is `200` with no session id; and the SDK's own `Client` + `StreamableHTTPClientTransport`, connected over the surface with a 5 ms reconnect delay, opens the GET once in 250 ms and raises no error, while `listTools` works.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-mcp-stateless-verbs.conformance.test.ts` (new, 29 tests): the REAL `MCPServerRuntime` as the `mcp` service on both doors (`createHonoApp` and `HonoServerPlugin` + dispatcher). Signed in, GET, DELETE, PUT, PATCH and OPTIONS answer `405` `Allow: POST` with the body intact on each door; signed-in `POST initialize` and `tools/list` answer `200`; anonymous GET, PUT, PATCH and OPTIONS answer `401` with no `Allow`; the parity loop holds the two doors to the same status and `Allow` for every one of those rows, including the verbs the standalone router does not mount. The package takes `@objectstack/mcp` as a devDependency and a source alias for it (`check:test-source-alias`).

**Ablation.** Each fix disabled by a reversible edit and restored the same way, `git status --porcelain` back to 0 lines, tests green again. (1) The transport's early return, `if (false && …)`. (2) The ``domainDecidesEveryVerb('POST', `${prefix}/mcp`)`` line, commented out, runtime rebuilt (the conformance package reads `@objectstack/runtime` from `dist`).

| suite | both fixes in | (1) out | (2) out |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mcp-server-runtime.http-verbs.test.ts` | 5/5 | 1/5 — the POST control passes; GET is `text/event-stream`, DELETE `200`, `Allow` `GET, POST, DELETE`; the SDK client opened the GET **41 times** in 250 ms | n/a (runtime not involved) |
| `hono-mcp-stateless-verbs.conformance.test.ts` | 29/29 | 7/11 at the first head (GET and DELETE answered `200` on both doors) | 17/29 — all 12 failures on the standalone door: signed-in PUT/PATCH/OPTIONS `405` with `Allow: DELETE, GET, HEAD, POST`, anonymous PUT/PATCH/OPTIONS `405` instead of `401`, and the 6 parity rows for those verbs |

## Local runs on `2f378a68b0`

- `@objectstack/mcp`: test 43 files / 538 tests pass; typecheck (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) pass.
- `@objectstack/http-conformance`: test 20 files / 275 tests pass; typecheck pass.
- `@objectstack/runtime`: test 444 files / 7095 tests pass (24 skipped); typecheck pass. Includes `dispatcher-plugin.routes.test.ts`, `dispatcher-plugin.fallback-absence-warn.test.ts` and the `actions`/`keys`/`notifications`/`mcp-skill` every-verb integration suites.
- `@objectstack/dogfood`: `showcase-mcp-http-identity.dogfood.test.ts` 6/6. Full suite on `d88a6ae069`: 295 files passed, 3 skipped; 2520 tests passed, 18 skipped; exit 0. Full suite on `2f378a68b0`: 295 files passed, 3 skipped; 2520 tests passed, 18 skipped; exit 0.
- ESLint on the touched files: clean.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --changed` for the new diff: 81 commands derived, 81 exit 0 (incl. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:error-status-conformance`, `check:route-envelope`, `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`).

## For the contract review

- The narrowing: GET `200` (empty stream) → `405`, DELETE `200` (no-op) → `405`, every verb's `Allow` → `POST`. Is DELETE in scope? The card names GET; DELETE is included because otherwise `Allow: POST` is false and the spec gives the same answer for a server with no sessions.
- The body is the SDK's JSON-RPC 405 shape, not the dispatcher's `buildApiError` envelope that `domains/*.ts` 405s use: it is the transport answering, like its other non-2xx answers (406, 400 parse error), and it is byte-for-byte what the SDK answered for PUT before.
- The anonymous decision comes first on both doors for every verb (`401` before the verb answer). Round 1 found that this was false for unmounted verbs on the standalone door; fixed in `2f378a68b0` as described under **Hosts**.
- The changeset now names `@objectstack/runtime` as well as `@objectstack/mcp`.
